history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review the criteria followed by it for identifying conditionality in the voluntary contribution agreements and bring them in line with the provisions of IPSAS 23.
history.administration_response: Although this recommendation was based on a transaction identified by the auditors and recognized as a one-off case by one of offices away from Headquarters, the Administration will continue to stress to all offices that they apply the provisions of IPSAS 23 in full.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration reviewed all contribution agreements other than with the European Union during 2019 at United Nations Headquarters based on IPSAS 23, the Board considers the recommendation implemented.
